Class ConnectionManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.network.ConnectionManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerAdapter, UpdateHandler
public class ConnectionManager extends Object implements ServerAdapter, UpdateHandler
Client-side wrapper around the active server connection that adds transparent automatic reconnection. It implements both ServerAdapter (so the client code keeps sending requests through it as if it were the real adapter) and UpdateHandler (so it intercepts the updates, errors and disconnections coming from the underlying
invalid reference 
RmiClient
/SocketClient).

Normal traffic is simply forwarded: requests go to the current adapter, while updates and errors are relayed to the registered downstream handler. On a disconnection it notifies the downstream handler and then spins up a background thread that keeps recreating the connection (via the ConnectionFactory, every RETRY_DELAY_MS) until it succeeds, after which it swaps in the new adapter and signals reconnection. The reconnecting flag guards against starting more than one reconnection loop at a time.

Reconnection is skipped after a terminal message: when a GameAbortedMessage or GameEndedMessage is seen, the game is over, so the connection drop that follows (e.g. the server shutting down on an abort) is expected and must not trigger a retry loop.

    • ConnectionManager

      public ConnectionManager(String ip, int port, boolean useRmi, ConnectionFactory factory, ServerAdapter initialAdapter)
      Creates a connection manager wrapping an already established adapter and registers itself as that adapter's update handler, so it can intercept incoming traffic and drive reconnection.
      Parameters:
      ip - the server host, used when recreating the connection
      port - the server port, used when recreating the connection
      useRmi - true to reconnect over RMI, false to reconnect over socket
      factory - the factory used to create new connections on reconnection
      initialAdapter - the adapter for the currently open connection

    • handleUpdate

      public void handleUpdate(ServerMessage message)
      Relays an update received from the underlying connection to the downstream handler. Before relaying, the message is inspected for a terminal notification (game aborted or ended): if it is one, reconnection is disabled so the connection drop that follows is not retried.
      Specified by:
      handleUpdate in interface UpdateHandler
      Parameters:

    • handleDisconnect

      public void handleDisconnect()
      Handles the loss of the underlying connection by notifying the downstream handler and starting a background loop that retries the connection (over RMI or socket, per useRmi) every RETRY_DELAY_MS until it succeeds; on success the new adapter is installed and the downstream handler is told it has reconnected. Re-entrant calls while already reconnecting are ignored.

      If a terminal message (game aborted or ended) has already been received, the drop is expected and this call returns immediately without reconnecting: there is nothing left to come back to.

      Specified by:
      handleDisconnect in interface UpdateHandler
